decision_interface: Image and motor decisions use separate calls. A fixed publicly verified orientation map converts the typed above/center/below image relation into the selected world-X direction.

visual_coarse.goal: Establish fine-positioning readiness during the initial approach to the patterned gray bowl.

image_decision: Current wrist RGB crop with its horizontal center line

visual_coarse.observable_exit_condition: Switch to numerical_fine when fine_readiness is true or the image classification is center.

numerical_fine.goal: Complete fine positioning and move the patterned gray bowl onto the cabinet, preserving the remaining sequence.
required_inputs: Current phase, gripper and holding feedback
numerical_fine.observable_exit_condition: Phase feedback indicates completion through retreat; task success is determined only by the unchanged native success signal.

feedback_constraints: Fine feedback is algorithm-derived from permitted images and robot state, never scene truth. Numerical tolerance, EEF coordinates and K/T are not model inputs.
